unauthorised_access.description: Data or code used without the right to it

data_leakage.description: Data sent where it should not go

procedure_violation.description: A required check, approval or stop was skipped

identity_and_delegation.description: Identity claims and agents using their own authority

prompt_injection.description: Instructions from untrusted content were followed

temporary_access.description: Short-lived access that was not closed

advisory.description: Warnings that never decide the label
